item.title: Fund for Investigative Journalism Awards 67 New Grants for Groundbreaking Reporting
item.description:

The grants cover the expenses of specific investigative stories, and recipients can also receive free editorial and legal assistance. The grants are being […]

item.title: Investigating Workers’ Compensation in New York, grantee finds a “long retreat”
item.description:
New York became the first state in the nation to set up a workers’ compensation system in the wake of the 1911 Triangle Shirtwaist Factory Fire. The program covers medical bills and cash for recovery time for countless injured workers. But in recent years, the program’s benefits have quietly shrunk by over a third, according […]

item.description:

Even though Florida law bars companies with such convictions from doing business with the state, the state has continued to contract with Armor […]

item.title: Grantee obtains new evidence that FBI uncovered serious misconduct by top Chicago jail official
item.description:

The FBI found that the official had been robbed at gunpoint outside of an illegal gambling den and fired […]

item.description:
